definitions.explanation: A person who serves on a committee or board.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{学級|がっきゅう}{委員|いいん}です。
{委員|いいん}に{選|えら}ばれました。
examples.english: I was elected as a committee member.

examples.japanese: {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}を{務|つと}める。
examples.english: To serve as an executive committee member.

notes:
{委員|いいん} refers to a member of a committee or board.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {委員|いいん}になる (become a committee member)
- {委員|いいん}を{務|つと}める (serve as a committee member)
- {委員|いいん}に{選|えら}ばれる (be elected as a committee member)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {委員会|いいんかい}: committee (the group itself)
- {委員長|いいんちょう}: committee chairman
- {学級|がっきゅう}{委員|いいん}: class representative
- {実行|じっこう}{委員|いいん}: executive committee member
